rule: Newcomers apprentice under a senior Keeper
texts: Each newcomer apprentices under a senior Keeper.
New apprentices do not tend a lantern alone.
The Council permits an apprentice to begin solo tending.

review.notes: "Ns must V" over a kind takes the reified deontic property (Inheritance newcomer (obligated apprentice)) at the plain-norm 1.0/0.99, with no compound action to decompose and no explicit quantifier word to record in a QuantifierPhrase companion. "newcomer" correctly fails both agent-nominalization tests, so no capability atom is emitted.

fields.sentence: Each newcomer apprentices under a senior Keeper.

review.notes: `Under` is the preposition actually used and falls under the open-class preposition-named oblique licence, not a coined head. The explicit-universal rule over `(Member $x newcomer)`, the dependent-existential Skolem `(sk_senior_keeper $x)` with its typing, the `senior_keeper` genus plus gradable-modifier genus, and the "each" QuantifierPhrase companion all follow the instruction set.

fields.sentence: New apprentices do not tend a lantern alone.
parse: (: new_apprentice_no_alone (Implication (And (Member $x apprentice) (Member $x new)) (And (Member (sk_tend $x) tend) (Agent (sk_tend $x) $x) (Theme (sk_tend $x) (sk_lantern $x)) (Member (sk_lantern $x) lantern) (Manner (sk_tend $x) alone))) (STV 0.0 0.9))

q2_gaps: bare subject-oriented adverbial of accompaniment ('tend a lantern alone'): nothing decides between the Manner oblique and the depictive concurrent-state route, and the two differ in what the strength-0 bundle ends up denying
review.notes: Negated verbal generic as a strength-0.0 distributing rule, the adjectival restriction as a premise conjunct, the dependent Skolem-function witness for the indefinite object and the absence of a QuantifierPhrase for plain 'not' all match the instruction set.

fields.sentence: The Council permits an apprentice to begin solo tending.

q2_gaps: an ACTIVE permission verb with an overt permitter ('The Council permits X to V'): the deontic sections map only modals and passive / participial wordings ('are permitted / allowed / forbidden to V') onto (Permitted e) or the kind-level (permitted <action>), and say nothing about an active permit / allow / authorize clause — so whether it is only an ordinary object-control event (the reading taken) or should additionally carry a (Permitted <complement>) status atom is undecided

whether an inceptive's mandatory (Ongoing <activity>) marker still applies when the inception itself sits inside an unrealized control complement: the control rule strips tense/status from the complement event, yet the Inception rule puts Ongoing on the activity one level down, so the parse asserts a top-level ongoing tending that the sentence never claims occurred
review.notes: Object-control routing (matrix Theme = the reified complement event, the object controller copied in as that event's Agent, no matrix role for the apprentice, no tense on the complement) and the inception pattern (begin event + Theme activity + Ongoing) both follow the instruction set, as does the no-Name common-noun treatment of the capitalized 'the Council' and the singular-collective no-distribution rule.
